title: Cyber Essentials Plus Lead Assessor (IASME licensed)
description: Intelance is a UK advisory and assurance firm and an IASME licensed Certification Body for Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus. We are adding experienced Cyber Essentials Plus Lead Assessors to our associate panel to lead UK client assessments from start to finish. This is an associate contractor role. Work is offered assessment by assessment, with no guaranteed volume. Each assignment is covered by a written statement of work that sets out the scope, timetable, location and fee before you accept it. Tasks Lead Cyber Essentials Plus assessments from scoping to certificate decision, in line with the current IASME and NCSC test specification. Check the Cyber Essentials self assessment and confirm the Cyber Essentials Plus scope is correct before testing starts. Work out the device sample and plan testing of user devices, internet gateways, cloud services and public facing services. Carry out remote and onsite testing, authenticated vulnerability scans and evidence checks. Record findings clearly, agree fixes with the client and manage retesting within the permitted timescale. Write complete assessment records and clear client reports. Review the work of other assessors on the panel before results are submitted, and give them practical feedback. Handle the larger and more complex assessments, such as multi site organisations and mixed Windows, macOS, Linux and mobile estates. Work through Intelance accounts, systems and quality checks, and protect all client information. Tell us about any conflict of interest before you accept an assignment. Requirements Essential Current IASME appointment as a Cyber Essentials Assessor and a Cyber Essentials Plus Assessor. We will check this with IASME. At least two years of delivering Cyber Essentials Plus assessments, with 20 or more completed in the last 12 months. Experience reviewing or signing off other assessors' work, or acting as Lead Assessor for a Certification Body. Based in the UK and able to attend client sites in the UK when an assessment needs it. Strong hands on knowledge of Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, firewalls, cloud services, multi factor authentication and vulnerability scanning. Able to explain findings in plain English to business owners and IT teams. Professional Indemnity and Public Liability insurance of at least £1m each before any client work starts. Two recent references for Cyber Essentials Plus work. Useful CISSP, CISM, CREST, OSCP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or another qualification accepted on the IASME assessor route. Experience with Qualys, Tenable Nessus or a similar approved scanning tool. IASME Cyber Assurance assessor status. Benefits Day rate of £375 to £550, or a fixed fee for each assessment agreed before you accept the work. A steady flow of scoped assessments from an established Certification Body, with no sales work for you to do. Remote preparation and reporting, with site visits only when the assessment needs them. Access to Intelance templates, scanning capability, secure collaboration tools and quality review. A clear route to a trusted associate role and more senior assurance work across ISO 27001 and IASME Cyber Assurance. You choose which assignments you accept. Apply with your CV and answer the short screening questions. Shortlisted applicants will be asked for IASME assessor evidence and two references. Please do not send any client material. title: Analytics Engineer
company: Legal Counsel - 12 month FTC at Rightmove Greenhouse
description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p><span style="color: rgb(0, 4, 67);"><img style="max-width: 100%;" src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/09/Untitled-30-July-2026-at-10.03.05-3-8.png" alt="" width="1001"><strong><br><br></strong></span></p> <p>Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.</p> <p>We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. </p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>Millions of people visit the Rightmove website every month. We have a huge amount of data about how people use the site, and what this means to our customers. You’ll be at the centre of our analytics platform to help drive this, modelling and productionising high‑quality data assets in DBT on BigQuery, and maintaining the semantic layer to power the insights that will impact millions of users.<br><br>Working closely with a highly collaborative and high-performing team of data engineers, analysts, and product teams, you will help standardise metrics, elevate data quality, and enable self‑serve analytics so teams can move faster and smarter to drive real business impact.<br><br>Ultimately, this role would suit an analytics engineer who’s ready to take ownership of building high-quality, well-documented data models, contribute to the development of a scalable analytics layer of a modern data stack, and help shape how data is used across the UK’s favourite property site.<br><br><strong>What You’ll Be Doing</strong><br>- Model, build, and productionise robust data assets using dbt and BigQuery<br>- Maintain and evolve the semantic layer in Looker to support consistent, self-serve analytics<br>- Ensure data is transformed, tested, and of high quality before consumption by downstream users<br>- Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand requirements and deliver trusted data models<br>- Document and expose data assets in a way that is easy to understand and use<br>- Apply and advocate engineering best practices across analytics codebases<br>- Maintain the data catalogue and support a single source of truth for analytics<br>- Analyse workflows and collaborate with data engineers to improve performance and maintainability<br>- Be proactive in identifying opportunities to reduce complexity and cost across the data platform<br>- Participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives</p> <p><br><strong>We're Looking for Someone Who</strong><br>- Has 3–5 years of proven experience in analytics engineering or data modelling, working on production-grade data models and semantic layers within a large-scale, cloud-based data platform<br>- Has hands-on experience with dbt and understands modular data modelling best practices<br>- Is confident writing and optimising complex SQL queries in BigQuery (or Redshift/Snowflake)<br>- Has experience working with Looker (Core) and maintaining semantic layers (LookML)<br>- Has worked in a production environment where data models are used to power business-critical reporting and dashboards<br>- Understands the importance of documentation, testing, and version control (Git) in analytics workflows<br>- Has experience working in a cloud-native environment - GCP highly preferred, also AWS<br>- Optimistic, curious and gets excited by tech, enjoys keeping up with current trends. Actively gets involved and enjoys contributing to tech events<br>- Is proactive, communicative, and comfortable contributing to technical discussions and design decisions<br>- Brings a collaborative and curious mindset, and enjoys working in cross-functional teams</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 4, 67);"><strong>Life at Rightmove</strong></span></h3> <p>Despite our growth, we’ve remained a friendly, supportive place to work, with employee #1 still working here!  We’ve done this by placing the Rightmove Hows at the heart of everything we do. These are the essential values that reflect our culture, and include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>We create value…</strong>by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.</li> <li><strong>We think bigger…</strong>by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.</li> <li><strong>We care deeply…</strong>by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.</li> <li><strong>We move together…</strong>by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.</li> <li><strong>We make a difference…</strong>by focusing on delivering measurable impact.</li> </ul> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"><code><a href="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/culture/" target="_blank"><img style="float: left; max-width: 100%;" src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/09/Job-alerts-1.png" alt="" width="452"></a></code></p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"> </p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;"> </p> <p>We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing   training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with <strong>89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work</strong>, we’re clearly doing something right!<strong> <br><br><img src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/07/Untitled-30-July-2026-at-10.03.05-1-2.png" alt="" width="1000" style="max-width: 100%;"><br></strong></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 4, 67);"><strong><img style="max-width: 100%;">What we offer</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments.</li> <li>Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan.</li> <li>27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes.</li> <li>Contributory stakeholder pension.</li> <li>Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life.</li> <li>Competitive compensation package.</li> <li>Paid leave for maternity, paternity, adoption & fertility.</li> <li>Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan.</li> <li>Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching.</li> <li>Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more.</li> <li>We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(0, 222, 180);"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; max-width: 100%;" src="https://www.rightmove.co.uk/careers/content/uploads/2026/09/Untitled-30-July-2026-at-10.03.05-8.png" alt="" width="1000"></span></strong></p> <hr> <h4><em>As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. <br></em><br><em>At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success. title: Senior Total Rewards Partner
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. Senior Total Rewards Partner, Total Rewards How you'll make impact As Airwallex scales globally and prepares for its next stage of growth, you’ll own and evolve the Total Rewards agenda across compensation, benefits, job architecture, benchmarking, equity governance and pay transparency. Own and evolve global compensation frameworks, salary structures, geographic differentials, market positioning, compensation cycles and financial models that support hiring, retention, executive decision-making and international expansion. Build and improve job architecture and leveling frameworks that support organisational scalability, internal equity and talent mobility. Shape regional and global benefits programmes, including plan design, annual renewals, broker and insurer negotiations, benchmarking and cost optimisation, while balancing employee value, fiscal discipline and local market requirements. Hands-on benefits administration isn’t the primary focus of this role. Partner with executive leadership, People Partners and Talent Acquisition to turn complex reward data into clear recommendations, challenge decisions that conflict with business strategy, market data or regulatory requirements, and lead Total Rewards initiatives from scoping and design through implementation. Support international market expansion by developing competitive, compliant and locally relevant compensation and benefits frameworks across global markets. What we're looking for Essentials 7+ years of progressive experience in Total Rewards, Compensation, or Benefits, ideally within high-growth technology or fintech environments. Proven track record of designing, building, and scaling global compensation frameworks, benefits programs, and equity structures in hyper-growth organisations. Strong expertise in compensation strategy, including market benchmarking, job and salary architecture, geographic pay differentials, compensation cycles, and financial modelling. Experience designing benefits programs and leading annual renewals, including broker and insurer negotiations. Hands-on benefits administration is not a primary focus. Practical experience managing compensation planning and equity programs, leading system implementations or migrations, and working with HR technology platforms such as Workday, BambooHR, Carta, Shareworks or Pave. Advanced analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate complex data and financial models into actionable insights and executive recommendations. Proven ability to influence and communicate Total Rewards decisions with senior leaders, People Partners, and Talent Acquisition, demonstrating sound business judgement and confidence in challenging decisions that conflict with business strategy, market data, or regulatory requirements. A builder mindset, with the ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and develop scalable solutions across global markets and time zones. Preferred Experience in a late-stage private, pre-IPO, or recently listed company, particularly navigating equity program transformation, strengthening rewards governance, and preparing for public-market readiness. Experience building scalable Total Rewards programs from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with end-to-end ownership and strong accountability. Experience advising C-suite and senior leadership stakeholders on compensation, benefits, equity and rewards governance. Strong analytical and financial modelling skills, including scenario modelling and assessment of financial implications. Experience partnering effectively across diverse cultures, functions and international teams, navigating time zones and varying local market requirements. Experience translating complex compensation, benefits and equity concepts into clear, actionable messages for business leaders, People teams and employees. You'll thrive here if You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders. You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability. You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones. You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect. You're comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA. Learn more about your team People and Talent is where the people infrastructure of a genuinely global company gets built. Our company is growing fast across multiple regions, hiring in highly competitive markets, while many of the systems and programs themselves are still being designed. That means the job is not to run established processes well — it is to define what great looks like for a global fintech at this stage of growth, and then build it. This is a team for the ambitious who want the resources and scope of a scaled business combined with the creative latitude of one still being shaped. If you want to influence how a truly global company hires, grows, and builds a talent dense organization, this is where people work becomes company-building work. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. Ensure teams optimise against measurable outcomes, including new users, customer acquisition cost, conversion, transfer volume, retention and lifetime value. Support high-value regional partnerships where relevant, establish effective commercial frameworks and ensure partnerships translate into measurable business results. Pricing, unit economics and profitability. Oversee market-level pricing strategies and unit economics, ensuring each country balances competitive customer propositions with sustainable margins. Challenge investment decisions, review corridor and channel profitability, and help teams identify opportunities to improve contribution and long-term commercial performance. Market intelligence and competitive strategy. Maintain a strong understanding of customer behaviours, diaspora communities, competitive dynamics, regulatory considerations and market-specific opportunities across Asia. Translate market insights into regional priorities and ensure Country Managers adapt their strategies to local customer needs. Cross-functional leadership. Partner with product, marketing, finance, operations, compliance and other central teams to align regional priorities with company-wide objectives. Establish clear decision-making frameworks, encourage collaboration and knowledge sharing across markets, and foster a culture of ownership, urgency and continuous improvement. You know how to set direction, coach leaders, build accountability and create high-performing teams. Strong P&L ownership: Demonstrated experience managing revenue, costs, budgets, forecasts and profitability. A strategic growth operator: Experience developing and overseeing annual strategies, quarterly plans and monthly execution priorities. You can translate business objectives into clear plans, measurable targets and consistent delivery. Commercially and analytically sharp: Strong understanding of customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, conversion, gross profit, retention, unit economics and channel performance. Strong budget and investment management: Experience overseeing multi-market budgets, identifying performance gaps, reallocating investment and balancing growth ambitions with financial discipline. Diaspora and distribution networks: Relationships with relevant community organisations, student associations, employers, influencers and other distribution partners across key sending and receiving markets. As we grow, there’s a big opportunity to evolve how our brand shows up and make those experiences feel connected.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Brand Designer</strong> to help shape the future of Monzo’s visual identity, lead and develop designers, and set a high bar for creative work across the company.</p> <p>You’ll join our digital-first internal creative studio and work closely with our Global Creative Director, designers and writers. You’ll also partner with teams across Product Design and Marketing, as well as external agencies, to bring ambitious ideas to life.</p> <p>This is for a designer who loves getting into the detail as much as shaping the bigger picture and helping others grow. You’ll bring strong conceptual thinking, art direction and typography to your work, and support a team of designers to do their best work too.</p> <h4><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Shaping our creative direction.</strong> Work with the Global Creative Director and partners across Monzo to evolve our visual identity and set a clear strategic direction for how the brand shows up globally.</li> <li><strong>Leading ambitious work. </strong>You’ll lead projects from idea to delivery and oversee work led by others, helping the team solve problems and deliver their best work. You’ll spot opportunities, create briefs and bring the right people together to make ideas happen. You’ll thrive working across multiple projects and teams at once.</li> <li><strong>Creating standout design.</strong> You’ll lead by example, setting a high bar for craft, concept and execution across the team. You’ll bring ideas to life across campaigns, marketing, product and other brand touch points, inspiring others through the quality of your work.</li> <li><strong>Managing and developing designers.</strong> Lead and support a small team of designers, helping them grow through regular feedback, coaching and career development conversations. Use Monzo’s levelling frameworks to support their progression and set clear expectations.</li> <li><strong>Raising the bar across the team.</strong> Lead critiques, share thoughtful feedback and mentor designers beyond your direct reports. Help create the conditions for people to do their best work.</li> <li><strong>Connecting brand and product.</strong> Partner with Product Design teams to bring Monzo’s brand to life in the app, including developing visual concepts, art direction and motion storyboards for customer experiences.</li> <li><strong>Evolving our brand systems.</strong> Develop guidelines, design principles and reusable assets that help teams create consistent, distinctive work as Monzo grows.</li> <li><strong>Influencing decisions across teams.</strong> Bring people together around a creative vision, explain the thinking behind your work and navigate trade-offs between customer needs, creative ambition and business goals.</li> <li><strong>Working with creative partners.</strong> Collaborate with external agencies and specialists, providing clear direction and feedback to make sure their work feels right for Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Improving how we work.</strong> Spot opportunities to make our creative process more effective, whether that’s through new tools, better ways of working or clearer guidance for teams.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have a strong portfolio of brand design and campaign work, showing how you’ve developed distinctive creative ideas and brought them to life across different channels.</li> <li>You’re an expert in your craft, with particular strength in <strong>typography, visual identity and art direction</strong>. You care about the details and can show how they make the overall work stronger.</li> <li>You have <strong>experience managing and developing designers</strong>, including giving feedback, supporting career growth and helping people do their best work.</li> <li>You’ve led complex creative projects from brief to delivery, making decisions, bringing people with you and maintaining a high standard throughout.</li> <li>You can think beyond a single project: you’ve helped shape a brand’s direction, developed design systems or guidelines, or improved how creative work happens across a team or organisation.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working with ambiguity. You can define a direction, navigate competing priorities and make thoughtful trade-offs without losing sight of the bigger picture.</li> <li>You’re proactive, creating your own briefs, bringing the right people together to accomplish your goals. You’re not just a doer, but a problem solver and a self-starter.</li> <li>You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, working across multiple teams and projects at the same time. </li> <li>You’re a confident collaborator who can explain and advocate for your ideas with designers, cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>You enjoy raising the quality of design beyond your own work, through mentoring, critique and sharing what you know.</li> <li>You’re highly proficient in Figma and comfortable using the tools you need to develop and deliver your ideas. You have a clear interest in AI tools and are keen to explore and use them to evolve how we work and what we create across design, marketing and product.</li> <li>You have experience working in a digital-first brand, creative agency or in-house team, and can show how your work has supported customer or business goals.</li> <li>You can develop ideas for motion and communicate them through storyboards or creative direction. You don’t need to be a motion specialist.</li> </ul> <p>We’d also love to see experience across areas such as web design, campaigns, print, film, illustration or 3D. You don’t need to be an expert in all of them.</p> <h4><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></h4> <p>💰 <strong>£98,000 - £114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</strong></p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home. All employees are given a MacBook.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Take a look at our<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> benefits</a>.</p> <h4><strong>🌈 The application journey</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>30-minute call with our Recruiter</strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Brand Design team. </strong></li> <li><strong>1-hour interview covering values & ways of working. </strong></li> </ul> <p>To be considered for this role you will need to include your CV and a portfolio showcasing your work. This will allow us to better understand your experience. We’d particularly love to see projects you’ve led from start to finish, including the thinking behind the work, the impact it had and your individual contribution.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using AI to support your application and interviews at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here</a>.</p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-TR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Staff Software Engineer, Inference
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></h3> <p>CoreWeave’s Inference team builds and operates the core cloud platform powering massive-scale GPU workloads for AI/ML, VFX, rendering, and real-time inference. Our stack is engineered for speed, scale, and cost efficiency—providing a powerful alternative to traditional hyperscalers where infrastructure is our core product operated at massive scale.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong> </p> <p>As a Staff Software Engineer on the Inference team, you will operate as a technical leader across multiple teams and services, driving architecture, performance, and reliability for CoreWeave’s Kubernetes-native inference platform. You will define and lead complex, cross-cutting design initiatives spanning request routing, adaptive scheduling, GPU resource management, and cost-per-token optimisation under strict P99 SLAs. In this high-impact role, you will implement advanced inference optimisations—such as speculative decoding and KV-cache reuse—while establishing performance benchmarking frameworks, guiding cross-functional alignment across infrastructure boundaries, and raising the bar for engineering rigour and observability practices across the organisation.</p> <h3><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).</li> <li>8+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems or cloud platforms, with a proven track record of leading cross-team or organisation-level technical initiatives at scale.</li> <li>Strong coding proficiency in Go, Python, or C++.</li> <li>Deep expertise in Kubernetes at production scale, including orchestration, scheduling, and service design.</li> <li>Strong understanding of networked systems, performance optimisation, and distributed system design.</li> <li>Hands-on engineering experience with inference systems, including batching/micro-batching strategies, caching, memory optimisation, mixed precision (BF16/FP8), and streaming token delivery.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to systematically improve tail latency (P95/P99) and platform reliability through metrics-driven engineering.</li> <li>Proven experience owning system-wide SLIs/SLOs, capacity planning, autoscaling strategies, and mentoring senior and mid-level engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct open-source or production contributions to modern inference frameworks (e.g., vLLM, Triton, TensorRT-LLM, Ray Serve, or TorchServe).</li> <li>Deep experience with GPU systems engineering and hardware performance optimisation (e.g., CUDA, NCCL, RDMA, NUMA, or GPU interconnects).</li> <li>Direct exposure to large-scale AI/ML infrastructure or hyperscale cloud environments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit?</strong></h2> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams—even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match.</p> <ul> <li><strong>You love to: </strong>Scale highly complex distributed architectures and mentor engineering cohorts to elevate technical standards across an organisation.</li> <li><strong>You're curious about: </strong>Pioneering low-latency inference optimisations and finding innovative shortcuts to optimise cost-per-token performance.</li> <li><strong>You're an expert in: </strong>Metrics-driven engineering, troubleshooting micro-bottlenecks, and delivering stable cloud platforms under strict multi-tenant constraints.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h3> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take-off, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. title: Senior Director, ML Software
description: <h2>About the job</h2> <p>Set the direction for Graphcore’s ML software, with accountability for organisational leadership, investment priorities and delivery across platform generations. As Senior Director of ML Software in Bristol, you’ll report to the VP of Software. Your organisation delivers the machine learning software and analysis tools that enable AI models to run on Graphcore’s platform. You’ll translate business objectives into multi year roadmaps, aligning resources, investment and delivery commitments. You’ll own outcomes from early platform bring-up through production release and support. Your remit spans machine learning frameworks, kernel libraries, hardware simulation, networking software, profiling and debugging tools. You’ll lead through senior engineering leaders, shape organisational structure and develop successors. Beyond your function, you’ll shape wider software priorities, influence executive decisions and sponsor initiatives across the organisation. </p> <h2>The team and culture</h2> <p>You’ll partner with silicon, hardware, architecture, system software, product and operations leaders to align roadmaps and resolve integration risks. With architecture leaders, you’ll challenge design assumptions across frameworks, simulation, collectives and tooling. Your leadership team will own achievable, adequately resourced plans, with clear expectations for milestones, quality and outcomes. You’ll resolve risks promptly, make portfolio trade-offs and escalate decisions requiring executive alignment. Delivery and quality measures will guide investment in continuous integration, automated testing, hardware-in-the-loop validation, regression coverage and release governance. You’ll turn incidents into lasting improvements, with reliability, security and testability treated as engineering outcomes. </p> <h2>What we’re looking for</h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Organisational leadership:</strong> You’ve led sizeable system software organisations through managers and senior technical leaders, accountable for complex, multi-team hardware and software programmes. You set clear expectations and hold leaders accountable for delivery, quality and business outcomes.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Building leadership capacity:</strong> You’ve scaled engineering organisations, shaped structures and workforce plans, and led performance management and organisational change. You coach senior leaders, develop successors and build the capabilities needed to meet changing product and business priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strategy and investment:</strong> You’ve owned multi-year roadmaps and delivery portfolios, aligning investment, capacity and commitments with business objectives. You make portfolio-level trade-offs under resource constraints, resolve critical technical dependencies and manage risks across competing programmes.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engineering quality and governance:</strong> You’ve set organisation-wide quality and release standards, supported by hardware-based automation, regression coverage and robust validation. You use delivery and quality measures, incident learning and risk governance to drive improvements across teams.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Executive influence:</strong> You’ve aligned senior stakeholders across organisational boundaries, resolved complex decisions and communicated strategic risks and investment choices. You translate technical trade-offs into implications for products, customers, operational resilience and business outcomes, contributing beyond your immediate function.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strategic and technical judgement:</strong> You balance delivery commitments and business outcomes with reliability, security, maintainability and long-term platform needs. Experience with machine learning software, hardware-software interfaces, AI accelerators, GPUs or high-performance computing would be valuable. </p> </li> </ul> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin.</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is seeking a <strong>Staff Platform Engineer</strong> to join our Platform Engineering team based in the UK or Ireland. Familiarity with Kotlin, Go a plus</li> <li>Deep Kubernetes and container orchestration knowledge</li> <li>Proven CI/CD and GitOps experience</li> <li>Infrastructure as Code expertise (Terraform)</li> <li>Strong AWS and cloud-native experience</li> <li>Experience operating distributed, high-availability systems</li> <li>Ability to influence without authority and communicate effectively across regions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with internal developer platforms or portals</li> <li>FinOps or cloud cost management experience</li> <li>Regulated or high-availability environment experience</li> <li>Backend development experience</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why Platform Engineering at FBG</strong></p> <p>Platform Engineering at FBG operates with a product-first mindset. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build the audience.</strong> Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.</li> <li><strong>Own marketing channels that drive revenue. </strong>Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue</li> <li><strong>Write copy that persuades.</strong> Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.</li> <li><strong>Sprint, test, implement.</strong> Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.</li> <li><strong>Build systems, not one-offs.</strong> Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.</li> <li><strong>Do whatever it takes to win.</strong> Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we expect from you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>1 to 3 years of experience</li> <li>Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results</li> <li>A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.</li> <li>Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency</li> <li>Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do</li> <li>Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do</li> <li>A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people</li> <li>Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Practical details</strong></h2> <p>Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Establish the working hygiene (clearly structured initiatives, honest status, well-maintained backlogs) that lets engineering, design, and leadership trust the plan. Technical and data judgement Apply technical judgement to guide product development within your areas, especially around AI/ML model integration, data processing, and analytics. Translate complex technical solutions into clear product decisions and communicate the trade-offs to stakeholders. Use behavioural data and analytics as a key input to decisions and prioritisation, alongside domain expertise and conviction. Research, validation and data Use usage analytics and behavioural data to track adoption and surface friction within your product areas, and build workflows to analyse and act on it. Favour observation over interrogation: watching people work usually tells you more than asking them what they want. Use user research and testing for what it does well, validating legibility, usability, and workflow fit. This evaluative feedback should carry real weight and is often decisive; workflow fit deserves particular care given our high-stakes users. Recognise the limits of research when it comes to direction: what we should build is synthesised from deep expertise across intelligence analysis, subject matter, data science, engineering, and design. For bets that cannot be validated up front, apply post-deployment discipline: define success metrics and evaluation timelines, commit in advance to the evidence that would change your mind, and assess honestly whether the bet is paying off. Organise and run internal alpha and beta testing, plus external testing where possible; partner with Customer Success to recruit proxy users and to surface the friction, workflow issues, and pain points that feed into execution and prioritisation. Working with AI: Co-Analyst Partner closely with the AI team to ensure AI features are genuinely useful, understandable, and aligned with what our users need. Help track and document the specific behaviours and styles built into Co-Analyst responses. Support the work to adapt Co-Analyst to the needs of specific external organisations. Raising the bar for product practice Contribute to the product function's processes, roadmapping systems, and prioritisation frameworks, and model their consistent use. Help define and track the metrics that indicate product success, adoption, and customer satisfaction within your areas. Act as a coaching and advisory resource for colleagues, sharing product craft across teams and mentoring less experienced team members as the function grows. Cross-functional collaboration Act as the connective tissue between product, engineering, machine learning, design, customer success, and research within your product areas, ensuring cohesive development cycles and smooth delivery. Partner closely with the design team on design and UX, engineering on build and AI/ML, and the research and analysis team on domain expertise, synthesising their input into coherent product decisions. Facilitate cross-team workshops to bring evidence and expertise together, and strengthen pre-sprint and in-sprint communication. You should apply if You have shipped complex products in technical domains, ideally AI/ML, data, or intelligence, and you do your best work owning a product area end to end: from opportunity definition to shipped customer value. You are as comfortable in the detail as in the plan. Writing a PRD, interrogating usage data, or pressure-testing a model integration with engineers is the core of your craft, not a chore. You hold evidence and conviction in balance. You know when user research should lead and when expertise-led judgement should, and you can make and defend either call. You do your best work in a founder-led, vision-led company. You know the difference between owning a vision and making a vision real, and the second is the work you enjoy. The pace and ambiguity of a growth-stage company is what you are looking for rather than what you are tolerating. You find genuine satisfaction in bringing order to messy tooling and processes, because you have seen how much leverage a well-run product operation creates. You make the people around you better. You share your craft, coach colleagues, and improve the processes you work within, without needing a title that says you must. Where this role can take you Deepen your ownership. Strong performance means broader ownership, higher-stakes bets, and more direct influence over product strategy. Help define how AI-native intelligence products get built. Co-Analyst is a category-shaping product, and the work you deliver will influence how the industry approaches human-AI analytical workflows. Grow with the Product function. As ExTrac scales, this role is the natural path towards senior product leadership. Progress on either track: ExTrac values the individual contributor and Manager paths equally, so you can deepen technical scope or take on people leadership as your responsibilities grow. Requirements ExTrac provides services to a number of government clients, some of which specify nationality criteria for individuals seeking security clearance. For this reason, we can only consider applications from individuals who are nationals of the UK, another NATO member state, Australia or New Zealand. 4+ years in product management, ideally in AI/ML, data science, or intelligence-related fields, with a proven track record of shipping complex products from concept through to delivery. Experience delivering product work in a startup or growth-stage company, with demonstrated ability to own a product area end to end with minimal oversight. Able to translate complex technical solutions into product decisions, judging when user research should lead (usability and workflow fit) and when expertise-led conviction should (what to build), and using data and analytics as inputs rather than the whole answer. Comfortable working hand in hand with engineering and ML teams, with a good understanding of how complex ML models are integrated into user-facing products, alongside data processing and analytics. Skilled at working with engineering, ML, design, and customer success, and at synthesising input from multiple disciplines into coherent product decisions in a collaborative, agile environment. Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present complex information clearly to executives, clients, and internal teams. Desirable Experience in threat intelligence, risk analysis, or geopolitical intelligence, or in other highly regulated or security-sensitive environments (e.g. government, defence). Experience working within complex, data-led startups or other high-growth digital environments. A foundation in machine learning, data analytics, or AI product management, particularly integrating complex ML models into user-facing products. Interview Process We aim to ensure that each person who interviews with our team has the opportunity to showcase their experience and strengths, and to have honest conversations about whether ExTrac and the role align with their career aspirations. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You'll work on translating complex physical and biomechanical data into clear, digestible metrics that support real-time decision-making for elite coaches, athletes, and medical teams.</p> <p>In this position, you'll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Work with a cross-functional team.</strong> You'll collaborate with Engineering, Quality Assurance, Product, Design and Scrum disciplines to deliver feature-rich mobile and the back-end services that power them.</li> <li><strong>Develop and deliver.</strong> You'll take ownership of specific features, defining low-latency communication interfaces across the stack and building user-facing application features that turn complex sensor data into clear, actionable insights.</li> <li><strong>Test new ideas.</strong> At Hudl, we iterate rapidly, deploying changes to the product hundreds of times daily across our Engineering team. experience.</strong> Hands-on experience developing native or cross-platform mobile applications, ideally with React Native (iOS and Android).</li> <li><strong>Systems mindset.</strong> You have experience working with different API styles, communication patterns for streaming data across mobile clients and back-end systems.</li> <li><strong>A team player.</strong> You understand that problem-solving is a team effort and enjoy collaborating with peers to learn, share knowledge, and build great software together.</li> <li><strong>User-focused.</strong> You're excited to build intuitive interfaces that translate complex physical or optical sensor data into digestible information for real-world users.</li> <li><strong>Willingness to learn.</strong> You have solid core engineering skills and are excited to dive into mobile frameworks, time-series data streams, or cloud architecture as needed</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Backend & Cloud Architecture knowledge:</strong> Hands-on experience with modern cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), microservice architectures, time-series databases, and CI/CD deployment pipelines.</li> <li><strong>Domain & Data Streaming experience:</strong> Background working with real-time video, wearable devices, or streaming optical/sensor data, ideally within sports technology or performance analytics.</li> <li><strong>Mobile CI/CD.</strong>Experience with mobile build and release pipelines (GitHub Actions), distribution platforms (TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution), and testing frameworks such as Jest and Detox.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Champion work-life harmony.</strong> We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit <span><a href="http://www.alpha-sense.com" target="_blank">www.alpha-sense.com</a></span>. Come join us.</span></p></div><p><strong>Location: London (In office presence required 1-2 days a week)</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>The Customer Success organisation is composed of four teams: pre-sales, customer success managers, account management and support. The CS org is dedicated to ensuring every client realises the full value of their investment in our platform, working as an integrated partner to help clients achieve meaningful outcomes and embed AlphaSense into their everyday decision-making.</p> <p>By blending industry knowledge, product expertise, and a deep understanding of client priorities, the team helps organisations uncover new use cases, accelerate adoption, and sustain long-term growth. Their close engagement with clients also creates a powerful feedback loop—informing product innovation, shaping content strategy, and ensuring that the evolving needs of the corporate community are consistently reflected in how AlphaSense delivers value.</p> <p><strong>About the Role: </strong></p> <p>As a Senior Customer Success Manager (Sr. CSM) at AlphaSense, you will be the strategic lead for our most complex and high-value accounts within the Corporate sector. You are responsible for navigating multi-million dollar global organisations and driving long-term ROI through technical group/individual training while ensuring company-wide adoption across multiple business units. You will manage a concentrated portfolio of strategic accounts, remaining at the forefront of product and Corporate vertical expertise, while scaling your impact across the organisation through account strategy, leadership and innovation.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Account Influence:</strong> Navigate and influence multiple business units and key power users across the world largest and most complex global organisations. Create a groundswell of positive user sentiment to drive renewals and expansion with Senior Leadership.</li> <li><strong>Architect Deep Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Synthesise complex usage into actionable insights. Design multi-quarter adoption roadmaps in tandem with your Account Management peers that align AlphaSense capabilities with business objectives.</li> <li><strong>Onboarding & Ongoing Training:</strong> As an expert on the product, you will guide new clients through onboarding, training, and best-practice adoption to ensure a strong foundation, both virtually and in person.</li> <li><strong>Technical & Domain Mastery:</strong> Independently lead sophisticated technical conversations regarding Managed Content Providers (MCP), APIs, and Large Language Models (LLMs) with technical stakeholders and platform owners.</li> <li><strong>Executive Presence & Communication:</strong> Command virtual and in-person rooms with executive presence, and leverage powerful, strategic follow-ups as a tool to drive adoption and link AlphaSense to specific Senior Leader business objectives.</li> <li><strong>Solo On-Site Leadership:</strong> Fully own high-stakes, multi-day on-site engagements and lead customer "Lunch & Learns,’’ tailoring presentations to diverse user groups and core personas using our WWH (Why, What, How) framework.</li> <li><strong>Company Innovation:</strong> engage in cross-functional initiatives outside the standard CSM scope, such as product feedback loops, hiring committees, mentorship programs and process innovation to improve team efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>4 -6+ years of professional experience in Customer Success or Account Management, with a proven track record of managing a strategic portfolio. </li> <li>Recognised as a "Vertical Expert". </li> <li>Ability to travel 20% of time. </li> <li>Possess the technical acumen to navigate complex conversations around data integrations, APIs, and AI-driven market intelligence solutions.</li> <li>Ability to identify the 5% of users who drive the majority of sentiment and influence within an account, focusing on high-level business outcomes over basic feature adoption.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with a demonstrable track record for collaborating internally in a cross-functional environment and onsite with customers. </li> <li>A natural leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and is committed to contributing to the "AlphaSense Playbook" through mentorship and internal innovation.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Recruiting Scams and Fraud</span></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">All official communications will come from an @<a href="http://alpha-sense.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://alpha-sense.com/&source=gmail&ust=1740162734907000&usg=AOvVaw2sfhQUZloRzVpQ4Yj1Ftlo">alpha-sense.com</a> email address.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our <a href="https://www.alpha-sense.com/careers/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.alpha-sense.com/careers/&source=gmail&ust=1740162734907000&usg=AOvVaw3I0CFwb1ser7ImCRD48YOl">Careers page</a>.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Talent Partner (12 month FTC)
description: Senior Talent Partner 📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 4 days WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £60,000 Street Group is scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan, and hiring is about to get harder: more senior roles, a higher bar, and a market where the best people don't apply; they get found and won. We need someone who owns how we hire, not just who we hire. We're looking for a TA Specialist with a truly commercial mindset: skilled at your craft, able to own searches end-to-end across every part of the organisation with full autonomy, and a trusted partner to the hiring managers you work with. Why this role exists now Our recruiting team is strong but stacked. We've recently raised investment and have ambitious goals to achieve, which means hiring across every part of the business at the same time. We need an experienced recruiter who can pick up roles anywhere in the organisation, switch between them easily, and partner with hiring managers without needing a steer, so the whole team can keep hiring quality people at pace. We're hiring this role initially on a 12 month FTC, but if our growth continues the way it's going (and we expect it will!), there's every chance it becomes a permanent position. The role You'll own searches end-to-end across the entire organisation, often running very different roles side by side. That means switching context quickly: getting up to speed on each team's goals, how its roles tie in to commercial goals and what good looks like for them. You'll work through ambiguity largely on your own, pulling in your manager only for the genuinely strategic or sensitive calls. Strong stakeholder partnering is at the heart of the role. You'll build trusted relationships with hiring managers across the business, handle competing demands between teams, and bring market and funnel insight into role and salary conversations, so hiring managers trust your evidence when you influence role definition, expectations and candidate decisions. Along the way, you'll keep improving how your own searches run: smoother pipelines with less drop-off of good candidates, better scorecards and smarter sourcing. Day to day, that looks like: Running a varied set of searches across the whole business end-to-end, from intake to offer. Partnering with hiring managers in every team: shaping briefs, setting expectations and balancing competing priorities. Running structured interviews to a high bar, making confident calls on borderline candidates, and coaching hiring managers through the process. Keeping candidates warm and informed through long, multi-stage processes, so no one ever goes dark. Using AI, approved templates and Ashby automations to keep routine work fast, so switching between roles doesn't slow you down. Building repeatable AI-assisted approaches (sourcing prompts, interview kits, funnel views) and sharing the useful ones with the team. Who we're looking for An experienced recruiter with deep, reliable expertise across the full recruitment lifecycle, and the curiosity to get up to speed quickly on any part of the business. Experience recruiting across a wide range of functions at once, and switching context between very different roles without losing pace or quality. Strong stakeholder partnering: you build trusted relationships with hiring managers, and have the credibility to influence and constructively challenge them with evidence, in writing and in the room, including pushing back on a brief without damaging the relationship. Confident, consistent judgement of candidates whilst operating at pace. If you've worked through a period of growth you will feel right at home here. An AI-native mindset: you don't just use AI tools, you re-engineer your own workflows with them, and you know where AI can be trusted and where judgement needs to take over. Someone who shares what they know and helps develop the people around them. Why you might not want to apply We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won’t be for everyone. If you want to specialise in one area. You'll be hiring across the whole organisation, often for very different roles in the same week. If you'd rather go deep in one function, this isn't the role for you. If you want to move into people management now. This is an individual contributor role and you'll be carrying your own reqs. You'll informally mentor and share knowledge, but there are no direct reports. If you're looking to own TA strategy or set standards for the whole team. Good ideas come from everyone in our team, but leading on this won’t be yours to own. If you prefer a steer on ambiguous searches. We need someone who works through unclear briefs independently, and only escalates the genuinely strategic calls. If AI feels like a threat rather than a tool. We love Claude Cowork, and have both built and used multiple other tools to improve and speed up our ways of working. We have a company-wide expectation that AI is utilised, so it will be a large part of this role. If you're a brilliant solo recruiter but you don't share what works. Evidence of knowledge sharing from prior roles will be assessed during the interview process. If that list sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why! We recognise that women and people from underrepresented groups often apply for jobs only when they meet every single requirement listed. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application! Who are Street Group? We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone. Why join Street Group? 🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week 🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!) 💪 Structured career growth and ongoing professional development 📚 £500 yearly L&D budget 🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away 🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us 👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay 🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured 🧘 Regular well-being initiatives 🚂 Public transport season ticket loans 🌷 Paid menopause leave 🌞 Holiday buying scheme 🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition 👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day 👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology 🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome! 🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon 🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours 🚴 Cycle to work scheme 🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme 🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company! Salary £50,000 - £60,000, depending on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know. We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place, and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. title: Graduate Sales Development Representative (London)

We work in close partnership with our customers to conceive, evolve, customise and operate our platforms, so they can focus on their core business. Our platforms power hundreds of apps for the biggest media brands in the world, including The Independent, New Scientist, The Spectator, Condé Nast, Reach, DMG Media, Hearst and many more. title: Chief of Staff, People & AI Transformation
description: We're looking for an exceptional AI-native operator to join Smartly as Chief of Staff, People & AI Transformation , working directly with our Chief People Officer. Smartly is a global technology company at the intersection of AI, advertising, and creativity. As AI transforms how businesses operate, we're rethinking how we organize work, build capabilities, and unlock productivity across our global organization.This is an opportunity to be at the center of that transformation. You'll help drive some of our most important strategic initiatives—from launching new R&D centers globally to building an entirely new approach to workforce planning. You'll create the operating rhythm that keeps our People leadership team aligned, accountable, and moving forward. And you'll build AI-powered tools, agents, and workflows that connect information, automate processes, and help us make better decisions. We're looking for a builder, not just a coordinator. You're the kind of person who sees a messy problem, builds a plan, gets the right people moving, and then asks how AI could make the whole process 10x better. What You'll Do Drive high-impact transformation projects Own the execution of strategic, cross-functional initiatives, including global expansion, workforce planning, organizational transformation, and AI-enabled ways of working. Translate ambitious priorities into clear project plans, milestones, deliverables, and accountability. Bring senior stakeholders together, unblock decisions, and ensure important initiatives move forward with urgency and discipline. Build AI-powered tools and operating systems Design and build AI agents, automations, and workflows that make our People organization more effective. Develop tools that connect People data with Finance, Operations, and business performance metrics to improve visibility into organizational effectiveness and transformation outcomes. Experiment with emerging AI technologies, prototype new solutions, and turn successful experiments into scalable workflows. Partner with technical and analytics teams to ensure solutions are reliable, secure, and useful. Be the operational engine of our People leadership team Establish a consistent cadence of planning, reporting, project reviews, and accountability across our global People organization. Create dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into strategic priorities, progress, risks, and decisions. Own the preparation of quarterly People business reviews for our CEO, turning complex information into sharp insights and compelling executive presentations. Help our Chief People Officer and leadership team stay focused on the work that matters most. Who You Are An AI-native builder. You don't just use AI tools—you've built agents, automations, or workflows that solve real problems. You're constantly experimenting with what's new. An exceptional operator. You're highly organized, detail-oriented, and relentless about follow-through. Nothing falls through the cracks. Entrepreneurial and resourceful. You thrive in fast-moving environments, figure things out independently, and love building from scratch. Confident and people-oriented. You enjoy meeting people, asking questions, and engaging senior leaders. You're comfortable pushing for clarity and accountability. Analytical and articulate. You can turn messy information into clear thinking, compelling presentations, and actionable recommendations. Intellectually curious. You learn quickly, challenge conventional thinking, and get energized by unfamiliar problems. You likely have 2–5 years of experience in a high-growth startup, founder's office, strategy and operations, consulting, product operations, or a similarly demanding environment.You don't need an HR background or a traditional Chief of Staff title. We're far more interested in what you've built, how you think, and what you're capable of becoming. Why This Role? You'll work directly with the Chief People Officer on initiatives that shape how a global technology company operates. You'll gain exposure to executive decision-making, international expansion, organizational strategy, AI transformation, and the future of work—while taking real ownership from day one. You'll have the freedom to experiment, build new tools, challenge existing processes, and make a visible impact. If you're ambitious, love solving hard problems, and want to help build the operating model of an AI-native company, we'd love to hear from you. About Smartly Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers. Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it. Visit Smartly to learn more. The processing of your information is described in our Candidate Privacy Notice . Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Software Engineer (C++/C#)
description: The financial industry is growing at a record pace, but our data providers are still stuck in the past — with cumbersome onboarding processes, complicated APIs, slow infrastructure, and expensive licensing costs. Databento is the market data platform for modern finance. The company provides real-time and historical data across futures, options, and equities through a unified API. By owning the entire market data stack end-to-end, Databento is the first platform of its kind to combine the performance and reliability demanded by the world's leading trading firms with a dramatically simpler developer experience. Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, IMC, Tower Research, Jump Trading, HRT, Jane Street, and SIG. We're looking for a midlevel or senior IC to join our core engineering team. You'll be responsible for implementing and maintaining our C# client library, and also working alongside our core engineering team on the most performance-sensitive parts of our codebase. Responsibilities Own and maintain our C# client library, ensuring it is robust, well-tested, and easy for external users to integrate with. Design, develop, and maintain high-performance server applications in C++. Write message parsers and feed handlers for direct market data feeds from trading venues. Optimize existing codebase for high throughput (millions of messages per second, up to 40+ gigabits) and low latency (measured in nanoseconds). Implement tools and libraries for petabyte-scale data processing and analysis. Collaborate with the systems team to implement best practices for build, deployment, CI/CD. Implement monitoring and improve application uptime. Ensure smooth feature rollouts and updates. Preferred background 5+ years of full-time software engineering experience, preferably at a trading firm, tech company, or high-growth startup. Strong proficiency in both C++ and C#. Experience with Java is a plus. Experience designing APIs with a strong focus on intuitive, developer-friendly interfaces. Familiarity with open source best practices, including release management, versioning, changelogs, issue triage, and backwards compatibility. Knowledge of systems programming, algorithms, data structures, multithreading, networked I/O, serialization, CPU architecture, kernel, and compilers. Experience working with multiprocess environments. Comfortable with lldb/gdb. Good communication skills and work ethic for a remote workplace. An interest in low-level optimization and performance engineering. An interest in financial data or algorithmic trading. We offer health, dental, disability, and life insurance benefits, as well as 401(k) matching for full-time employees. We accommodate 100% remote work, with teammates living around the globe and paid in their local currency. The base salary range for this role is $150,000–$250,000, benchmarked to Tier 1 locations in each country. Total compensation may also include bonuses, commissions, and equity, depending on the role. Notice about phishing scams Be cautious of phishing scams impersonating Databento that offer fake job interviews and request purchases. Official emails come only from us.greenhouse-mail.io (our ATS). title: Shared Services Manager
description: We are looking for a Shared Services Manager to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen. The Role Reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services, you lead day-to-day service delivery: queue health, SLAs, escalations, quality and business continuity, with functional leadership and coaching for colleagues. You also own UK HR operations, from onboarding and right-to-work to payroll and benefits cover, offboarding and contractors. You partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT and external partners including the Home Office, our payroll provider, Papaya, brokers, insurers and NEST. Success means healthy queues, SLAs met and 100% audit-ready right-to-work records.
