title: Senior Franchise Producer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><h1><strong>Senior Franchise Producer</strong></h1> <p><strong>Franchise Development // PlayStation Studios™</strong></p> <p>PlayStation Studios has created some of the most loved worlds, characters, and stories in entertainment. Our opportunity now is to build those IP with greater intention — growing audiences, deepening fandom, and creating more ways for people to engage with PlayStation franchises beyond the release of a game.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Franchise Producer to help turn that ambition into coordinated high-quality work across a varied portfolio of franchise initiatives.</p> <p>This is a project management and production role with an unusually broad remit. The producer may support or lead work across franchise resources and documentation, location-based experience, linear media, publishing, internal partner and contractor-led projects, and other initiatives that bring franchise strategy to life.</p> <p>The role sits within a broader production team and contributes to shared sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery. While the team works collectively, this senior producer will independently own a defined set of workstreams from planning through completion.</p> <p>A major part of the role is partnering with teams across Sony Interactive Entertainment to translate franchise strategies and roadmaps into executable plans, track activity and dependencies, and directly produce selected initiatives where appropriate.</p> <p>This producer will also work closely with stakeholders within the PlayStation Studios’ development studios, coordinating approvals and reviews throughout production, maintaining trusted relationships, and ensuring that franchise work reflects both studio intent and wider PlayStation priorities.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own a portfolio of franchise production workstreams from initial brief and scoping through delivery, review, launch, and closeout.</li> <li>Translate franchise strategies and roadmaps into practical project plans with clear objectives, milestones, owners, dependencies, budgets, risks, and decision points.</li> <li>Track franchise activity across teams, maintain integrated plans and status reporting, and provide clear visibility of progress, risks, trade-offs, and required decisions.</li> <li>Produce selected franchise initiatives directly, coordinating internal contributors, studios, external partners, and vendors to deliver against agreed creative, quality, schedule, and budget expectations.</li> <li>Support a varied range of productions, which may include location-based experiences, publishing projects, franchise resources, documentation, presentations, toolkits, and partner-facing materials.</li> <li>Lead day-to-day project communication, meetings, action tracking, production reviews, approvals, and follow-up across multiple concurrent workstreams.</li> <li>Partner across PlayStation Studios, Portfolio Strategy, PlayStation Productions, brand, marketing, insights, finance, consumer products, licensing, legal, and Sony Group teams to align plans and unblock delivery.</li> <li>Scope, onboard, brief, and oversee contractors, agencies, and specialist production partners; manage deliverables, capacity, performance, and associated resource needs.</li> <li>Contribute actively to team sprint planning, backlog management, prioritization, estimation, retrospectives, and continuous improvement as part of the wider franchise production team.</li> <li>Create and maintain production standards, templates, trackers, documentation, and repeatable ways of working that improve clarity and consistency across the team.</li> <li>Identify issues early, recommend practical solutions, escalate appropriately, and keep work moving through ambiguity and changing priorities.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Substantial production or project management experience in games, entertainment, media, experiential, publishing, consumer products, licensing, or a related creative industry.</li> <li>A track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and concurrent deadlines.</li> <li>Strong command of production fundamentals, including scoping, scheduling, budgeting, resource planning, risk management, approval workflows, status reporting, and delivery governance.</li> <li>Experience translating strategic or creative ambition into structured plans, practical next steps, and high-quality deliverables.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the judgment and confidence to work with senior leaders, creative teams, specialist functions, and external partners.</li> <li>Clear and concise communication, with the ability to adapt detail for working teams, studio leadership, and executive audiences.</li> <li>A highly collaborative approach, combined with the accountability to own workstreams and drive them through to completion.</li> <li>Experience working in agile or sprint-based teams and contributing to shared planning, backlog, prioritization, and review routines.</li> <li>Experience briefing and managing agencies, contractors, vendors, or other external production resources.</li> <li>Experience in one or more of the following is a plus: location-based entertainment; publishing, including books or comics; franchise or IP documentation; licensing or consumer products; live experiences; or multi-format entertainment production.</li> <li>Knowledge of games and the PlayStation ecosystem is valuable, but relevant experience from adjacent entertainment sectors is equally welcome.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The Ideal Candidate</strong></h2> <p>The ideal candidate is a calm, proactive, and highly organized senior producer who enjoys bringing structure to ambitious creative work. They can move comfortably between long-range roadmaps and the operational detail needed to deliver a specific project.</p> <p>They are equally effective facilitating a team sprint, building an integrated plan, briefing a contractor, preparing a studio review, or helping cross-functional partners understand how their activity contributes to a wider franchise roadmap.</p> <p>They build trust through clarity, follow-through, and good judgment. They know when to drive, when to facilitate, and when to escalate. They are motivated by collective success, while being fully accountable for the workstreams placed in their care.</p> <h2><strong>Success in This Role Looks Like</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Assigned productions have clear plans, accountable owners, realistic schedules, visible dependencies, and well-managed risks.</li> <li>Franchise strategies and roadmaps are translated into coordinated activity that progresses across PlayStation and Sony teams.</li> <li>Studio stakeholders and cross-functional partners experience a clear, responsive, and trusted production process with timely reviews and approvals.</li> <li>Projects and resources are managed responsibly, with issues surfaced early and delivery kept aligned to creative intent, quality, timing, and budget.</li> <li>The wider production team benefits from strong sprint participation, transparent workload planning, dependable ownership, and improved tools and ways of working.</li> <li>The producer successfully owns multiple workstreams while contributing flexibly to the collective priorities of the Franchise Development team.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.</p> <p class="p1">Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p><em>Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.</em></p> <p><em>We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond. </em></p> <p><em>Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.</em></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: VP Data Centres
description: <p><strong>ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD</strong></p> <p>NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.</p> <p>We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.</p> <p><strong>THE ROLE: VP OF DATA CENTRE STRATEGY</strong></p> <p>Everything we sell depends on having the right power, in the right place, at the right time. Until now, decisions about where we build, who we partner with and how we secure capacity have been spread across the business. This new role brings them under one owner: someone who sets NexGen’s global data centre strategy and makes sure capacity is there before customers need it.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role, and it covers both strategy and execution. One day you’re taking a site recommendation to the executive team. The next you’re across the table from a colocation operator negotiating a multi-year contract. We plan to build a dedicated development function over time. Until then, you’ll do more of the hands-on delivery work yourself, and you’ll help decide when that team gets built.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING</strong></p> <p>Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:<br>- Build and own NexGen’s global data centre strategy and the 12–36 month capacity roadmap, so capacity is never the reason we miss a customer commitment<br>- Decide which markets and regions we expand into, set the criteria for choosing sites, and build a pipeline of data centre opportunities against them<br>- Make the call on colocation vs. owned infrastructure, and own the investment case for each site<br>- Secure reliable, cost-effective power for GPU-dense workloads, in line with our 100% renewable commitment, and spot grid and capacity constraints before they hit customers<br>- Lead the big negotiations on colocation agreements, power contracts and strategic vendor deals, and hold partners to their SLAs<br>- Set NexGen’s position on data sovereignty and planning across jurisdictions, and deal with regulators and government directly when the stakes are high<br>- Bring cost per MW and cost per GPU rack down, and make sure capex goes where the commercial pipeline needs it</p> <p><strong>ABOUT YOU</strong></p> <p>We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:</p> <p><em>Essential:</em><br>- 10+ years in data centre infrastructure, with significant time in a senior strategy, development or commercial role<br>- A proven track record in site selection, colocation negotiation and data centre partner management at scale<br>- A deep understanding of power procurement and capacity planning, and of the commercial side of running GPU-dense AI infrastructure<br>- Experience negotiating complex, multi-year contracts with data centre operators and vendors<br>- An established network across the colocation ecosystem, plus experience at or with neoclouds, hyperscalers or GPU infrastructure platforms</p> <p><em>Nice to Have:</em><br>- Power procurement for high-density compute specifically, rather than general enterprise space<br>- Grid connection, sovereign cloud or government engagement in more than one jurisdiction<br>- Existing relationships with renewable power providers or experience structuring PPAs<br>- Experience growing an infrastructure function from a standalone role into a team, including deciding when to bring in dedicated delivery capability</p> <p><strong>WHAT WE OFFER</strong></p> <p>- Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme<br>- Employee wellbeing benefits<br>- 25 days holiday, plus public holidays<br>- Private Medical Insurance<br>- Enhanced Pension Scheme<br>- Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)<br>- Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment<br>- Visible, meaningful impact as we scale<br>- Clear career progression in a high-growth company<br>- A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership<br>- The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future</p> <p><strong>WHY APPLY</strong></p> <p>We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>MORE INFORMATION</strong></p> <p>Visit our <a href="https://www.nexgencloud.com/careers">careers page</a> to learn more about us or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexgen-cloud">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://x.com/CloudNexgen">X</a> to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.</p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

easy to understand, non-technical manner.</li> <li>Outgoing, can-do attitude.</li> <li>Great communication skills.</li> <li>Business acumen and a self-starter mindset.</li> <li>20% travelling regulations and reporting breaches.</li> <li>Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Why Jamf?</strong></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <ul> <li data-renderer-start-pos="9313">Named a 2025 Best title: Senior Legal Counsel
description: About Zego 🚀 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing. Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive. We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook. We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers. Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor . If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. Purpose of the role As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be Zego’s senior in-house lawyer, owning legal matters across the business and working closely with senior stakeholders as Zego continues to grow. Reporting to the Group CFO, you will work alongside Compliance and the wider Legal and Regulatory Affairs (LRA) team. It’s a varied, hands-on role with a high degree of ownership and autonomy. You will be the go-to person for legal advice across the business: advising on key decisions, drafting and negotiating commercial contracts, and instructing external counsel where needed. This is an individual contributor role with no line management. A particular focus will be insurance law and regulation, which sits at the heart of Zego’s business, alongside a broad range of commercial and contractual matters. You’ll work closely with colleagues responsible for compliance, financial crime and risk, providing legal advice on the regulatory questions that arise, while those teams retain responsibility for their respective areas. What you will be doing Insurance distribution and capacity. Draft and negotiate binding authority agreements, co-insurance and cooperation agreements, claims handling agreements, reinsurance-related documents. Insurance products. Work with Underwriting, Product and Claims on policy wordings, endorsements and coverage questions, including large losses. Regulatory legal advice. Advise on the structuring of insurance arrangements, including binding authority agreements, insurer and distribution relationships, regulatory permissions and perimeter questions, and the legal and regulatory requirements that apply to Zego's insurance and lending activities. Commercial. Draft and negotiate supplier, outsourcing, technology, partnership and data sharing agreements, including material outsourcing terms required by FCA and GFSC rules. Corporate and governance. Support board and committee governance, intra-group agreements, financing and capital projects, and company secretarial work in the UK and Gibraltar. Legal operations. Keep templates, playbooks and self-serve tools current so the business can handle routine matters (such as NDAs) without Legal. External counsel. Scope instructions, manage budgets and hold firms to account on quality and timing. What you'll need to be successful: Qualified to practise in England and Wales, with around 6+ years' PQE gained at a law firm, in-house, or both. Substantial experience of insurance law and regulation, ideally advising an MGA, broker or insurer. Experienced in drafting and negotiating complex commercial agreements, with sound judgement on which points matter and which to concede. Comfortable working on your own with a high volume of varied matters and competing deadlines. Able to explain legal risk clearly and briefly to senior leaders and boards, and to give a recommendation, not only the options. Establish clear standards for what enters the platform and how conflicting information is handled. Build ingestion beyond APIs. Develop reliable pipelines for structured datasets, external APIs, documents and published guidance. Judgment about the data itself. You can evaluate whether a source is fit for a particular use, reconcile inconsistent information and make uncertainty or gaps visible to downstream consumers. Experience with messy external sources. You’ve handled inconsistent formats, changing schemas, incomplete records, rate limits and integration failures. You’re comfortable working beyond clean, well-documented APIs. A product mindset. You care about the decisions your data supports. You can work with domain experts and product engineers to translate an ambiguous need into a useful data product. Architectural ownership. You can review an existing system, establish a direction and deliver improvements incrementally. Familiarity with GCP, where we run our infrastructure, and experience working alongside backend engineering teams. Experience establishing data standards or helping build a data team. This role isn’t for you if You just want to keep the pipelines running. You’ll need to care about which data we use, whether it can be trusted and how it improves the decisions our products support. You want a fully specified architecture to implement. We need someone who can assess what exists, challenge assumptions and take ownership of the technical direction. You only want to work with clean, structured data . Important information arrives through documents, policy announcements and inconsistent external sources. Making it usable is part of the job. You want to stay removed from the product or domain. You’ll work closely with product engineers and property experts. Understanding what the data means and how it is used is essential. title: Research Scientist, Embodied AI

title: (Senior) Account Manager (Creative Automation)
description: <p><em><strong>This is a 12 month fixed term contract initially with strong likelihood of extension and a beginning of January 2027 start date.</strong></em></p> <p><em><strong>Please note that the internal job title for this role is TBC.</strong></em></p> <p><em>DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.</em></p> <p><strong>JOB PURPOSE</strong></p> <p><em>This role is part of our </em><strong><em>Global Studios</em></strong><em> team. We create emotive yet conversion-focused ideas, products and campaigns at scale and speed. Our specialty is hyper-personalised, digital communications that change perceptions, shape new behaviours, and shift market share for our clients.</em></p> <p>As part of DEPT’s Creative Automation team, you will bridge design teams, project management, and technical execution. In this role, you will lead creative automation campaigns, oversee integrated deliveries, and support hands-on data feed setup using Google Sheets to power our automated workflows. Working closely with designers, Creative Automation specialists, developers, account managers and external stakeholders, you will translate campaign briefs into efficient data schemas, streamline production pipelines, and ensure high-impact creative execution while maintaining agency profitability and technical integrity. </p> <p>If you’re adept at problem-solving within data sets, have a passion for streamlining workflows, and are excited by the intersection of design and technology, this role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a highly relevant and evolving field.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bridge the gap between non-technical client service teams and technical specialists, helping colleagues understand the capabilities and limitations of creative automation systems.</li> <li>Lead requirements gathering for data feeds and briefing documents with internal and external stakeholders, asking the critical questions needed to design robust schemas.</li> <li>Build, manage, and debug data feeds from scratch using advanced Google Sheets formulas, ensuring configurations are streamlined, error-proof, and easy for cross-functional teams to use.</li> <li>Design user-friendly, structured input documents for client data collection that minimize data-entry errors and simplify maintenance.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with automation designers to align data feeds with design templates, running rigorous QA testing to prevent production and rendering errors.</li> <li>Continuously improve ways of working and processes in data feeds and cloud rendering to ensure efficiency and ongoing optimisation.</li> <li>Oversee end-to-end delivery of multiple integrated and automated campaigns, ensuring all projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.</li> <li>Distill and translate client feedback into clear, actionable direction for designers, copywriters, and developers.</li> <li>Build and cultivate strong client relationships through video conferences, briefing sessions, and campaign evaluation reviews.</li> <li>Partner with the team to review, test, and deploy final creative assets across client-owned channels.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING</strong></p> <ul> <li>High proficiency in spreadsheets with advanced Google Sheets formula skills and an aptitude for mastering custom formulas and data manipulation.</li> <li>Strong foundational grasp of relational databases, data normalization, and data-entry error prevention.</li> <li>Proven track record delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital and direct channels, such as dynamic display banners, social, and email.</li> <li>Strong relationship management skills with the confidence to advise clients, partner with external suppliers, and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>Exceptional organizational and scheduling abilities to balance competing priorities, manage tight turnaround times, and hit deadlines consistently.</li> <li>Sharp attention to detail with an uncompromising standard for quality control across both data and creative output.</li> <li>Outstanding oral and written communication skills, skilled at translating technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and internal teams.</li> <li>Innate curiosity and drive to optimize processes, streamline workflows, and grow within a fast-evolving discipline.</li> </ul> <p><em>Nice to have:</em></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience with creative automation tools and a working understanding of the creative production pipeline (e.g., Adobe After Effects, cloud/AWS rendering, and interactive production).</li> </ul> <p><strong>WE OFFER</strong></p> <ul> <li>A flexible hybrid working policy to enjoy the best of both worlds (2 days from the office, depending on location).</li> <li>Early Finish Fridays, kickstart your weekend early with alternating early-finish Fridays.</li> <li>26 days paid holiday, plus UK Bank Holidays.</li> <li>Access to dedicated mental health resources including enhanced sick pay scheme, employee assistance programme and trained Mental Health First Aiders. </li> <li>Company Pension Scheme. </li> <li>Access to a Private Medical Insurance or Cash Plan scheme. </li> <li>Season Ticket Loan, interest-free Season Ticket Loans to help spread the cost of travel.</li> <li>Cycle to Work Scheme, save money on a new bike and equipment.</li> <li>EV Car Scheme, access to an electric vehicle via a salary sacrifice arrangement.</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly policies to support parents.</li> <li>Workplace Nursery Scheme, save on childcare by paying for nursery fees through a tax-efficient salary sacrifice scheme. </li> <li>DEPT® Allowance, a dedicated company contribution to spend on either your professional development or personal wellbeing.</li> <li>Social and Cultural Events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.</li> <li>Learning and Development, continuous growth opportunities through internal training, and "inspirational talks” guest speakers.</li> <li>Buddy Program, you will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you navigate your first weeks’ at DEPT®.</li> <li>A Certified BCorp Agency and is multi-award winning “Agency of the Year”. </li> <li>Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global, at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!</li> <li>Global <a href="https://www.deptagency.com/dept-cares-day-2023/">DEPT® Cares Month</a>, an annual initiative where our teams donate their professional skills and time to support local charities and pr-bono projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHY DEPT®?</strong></p> <p>We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.</p> <p>We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.</p> <p>At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.</p> <p><strong>DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION </strong></p> <p>At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.</p> <p>Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.</p> <p>We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.</p> <p>Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts <a href="https://www.deptagency.com/the-good-company/">here</a>.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - UK&I
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><div class="m_8972703100365155930Ltr m_8972703100365155930OutlineElement m_8972703100365155930SCX45225805"> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><span data-sheets-root="1">This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</span></span></p> <p><strong>You should apply if: </strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><strong>You want to impact the industries that run our world: </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><strong>Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><strong>You have innate curiosity in how businesses work:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><strong>You build genuine relationships with your customers: </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 300;"><strong>You want to be with the best: </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. </span></li> </ul> <p><strong>This may not be the right role for you if: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You aren’t willing to put in the work: </strong>Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. </li> <li><strong>You aren’t a team player: </strong>At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by <strong>sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.</strong></li> <li><strong>You have nothing more to learn</strong>: Every Samsarian has a growth mindset and believes that what got us here won’t get us there.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em>This is a pure hunter role focused on 90% net-new logo acquisition,"</em> and <em>"Candidates must have a minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role.</em>Work on strategic account mapping & outbound prospecting</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close</span></li> <li><span style="font-weight: 400;">Work collaboratively with a team of internal / cross-functional stakeholders to remove deal blockers</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for this role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience in a pure hunter role focused on 80-90% net-new logo acquisition</li> <li>Minimum of 24 months' experience in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience handling complex mid-large deal cycles</span></li> <li>Value-based selling approach</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills and curious by nature</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Comfortable in a dynamic, customer facing environment</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">MEDDIC experience</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Highly collaborative with a growth mindset</span></li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. title: Software Engineer, Research Platform
description: Software Engineer, Research Platform About Us Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData and our Trillion Gene Atlas (TGA), the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. The Role We're seeking an exceptional Software Engineer, Research Platform to join our team in London, embedded in our AI, genomics and computational biology teams. Your goal is to accelerate their research by bringing production-grade engineering to the systems they depend on. This is an embedded role. You'll sit with the scientists, understand what they are trying to find out, and build the systems that get them there faster: making research code reliable, reproducible and fast; designing data pipelines and workflows that run at the scale of BaseData and the Trillion Gene Atlas; and building the tools and infrastructure that let a small research team run far more experiments. You'll move between genomics, computational biology and ML work as the research requires, and own what you build end to end. The engineering problems are substantial: petascale biological data, workflows that span cloud and HPC, and research that is often limited by how quickly an idea can be turned into a result. You'll report to the Head of Platform as part of our engineering team, which spans London and Boston, and work day to day within the AI research, genomics and computational biology teams in London. About you A very strong engineering background: complex production systems you have designed, built and owned. Expert in Python; strong habits around testing, code review and CI/CD. You take responsibility for the outcome. If that means learning something new or working outside your usual area, you do it. A solid understanding of data pipelines, workflow orchestration, distributed execution and scalable compute (Kubernetes, HPC, containers). You can take a researcher's code, understand the question behind it, and make it robust without losing what made it useful. A real interest in biology, ideally with experience of genomic, protein or sequencing data. You will learn the science well enough to understand the research, not just its code. Collaborative and low ego. We care about drive, and in a small team everyone depends on what you build. Nice to have Research or applied experience in computational biology, bioinformatics or genomics. Experience with bioinformatics tooling and sequencing data at scale. Familiarity with Dagster or similar orchestration, Kubernetes, cloud and HPC compute. Experience building tools, MCP servers or workflows that AI agents and researchers use to run computational experiments. What we offer in return Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics. Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points. High Growth: We truly believe in investing in our top talent, we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact. Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions so strong that most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike to work scheme, life insurance, and more. Do you want to join our team as our new Software Engineer, Research Platform? Then we'd love to hear from you. Self-motivated: You take initiative, follow through, and bring energy to everything you do. Your Package We are committed to providing a transparent, supportive, and rewarding work environment. Compensation & Growth Competitive Reward: Salaries are externally benchmarked annually to ensure market-aligned compensation. Clear Career Path: A straightforward, open progression framework means you'll always know the path to promotion and how to achieve your next career goal. Wellbeing & Time Off Holiday: 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, plus an extra 3-day company-wide shutdown at year-end. Financial & Health Security: Robust benefits including a market-leading pension scheme, comprehensive private health insurance for you and your family with NO excess, critical illness, and life assurance. Enhanced Leave: Enhanced paid family leave to support all new parents. Work Environment & Culture Hybrid Working Truly Inclusive Time Off: Our 'Bank Your Bank Holiday' program allows you to exchange public holidays for dates that hold personal or cultural significance to you. Vibrant Social Culture: From regular Town Halls and team picnics to organised sports events, our social committee ensures frequent opportunities to connect and celebrate. Green Commute: Cycle-to-Work scheme and convenient office locations near major transport hubs. Ready to Build the Future? If this opportunity excites you, apply now! title: Customer and Client Support Specialist
description: About Us Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country. Role Overview We’re looking for a Customer and Client Support Specialist to join our support team in Croydon. You’ll help two groups of people: the drivers who park at our sites, and the landowners and asset managers we work with. Most of the job is email, through Zendesk. This isn’t answering from an FAQ. A good reply means reading the message properly, working out what’s actually being asked, checking the facts across our systems, and writing an answer that solves the problem without creating a new one. Some drivers will be angry, and some will be wrong but loud. We need someone who stays calm, gets it right, and follows up until it’s fixed. It’s a role for a “learn-it-all” who cares about getting small things right, ticket after ticket. Almost everything is teachable in your first couple of months, and there’s plenty of room to grow as the company does. Key Responsibilities Respond to driver and client enquiries by email, clearly, accurately and on time. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The opportunity Consumer Growth helps customers get more value from the Kraken app. We improve how people discover relevant features, build confidence using them, and keep coming back. We work closely with Product, Design and Data to understand customer behavior, identify opportunities and test ideas. Our engineers help shape what we build. You’ll bring ideas to the table, challenge assumptions and own your work from the initial hypothesis through launch, measurement and iteration. Ship fast experiments, from a couple of days to a couple of weeks, to improve conversion and retention in the Kraken app. Find funnel drop-offs and turn them into testable ideas, then build, measure and iterate. Design, develop and maintain high-quality React Native features for our consumer mobile app. Help customers discover and adopt relevant features through improvements to customer journeys, incentives and A/B tests. Use AI to build quickly, then review and ship with a high quality bar. Deliver polished, user-friendly UI that makes the product feel great to use. Build for correctness, accessibility, performance and reliability, with testing appropriate to the change. Work closely with Product, Design, Data and Backend Engineering to define hypotheses and measure results. Instrument your work so the team can evaluate customer behavior and experiment results, and use what you learn to improve, expand or stop an experiment. Turn successful experiments into reliable, maintainable product experiences. Proactively spot gaps and opportunities, and take ownership of the outcome. What you bring Strong experience building production mobile apps with React Native and TypeScript. A product and growth mindset, focused on moving metrics rather than just shipping code. Evidence of product impact: you can explain what you built, why you built it and what you learned after launch. Curiosity about data, and comfort using analytics tools such as Mixpanel and Segment. Experience working in a scale-up or other high-growth, fast-moving environment. Fluency in using AI tools to build, review and ship code, while retaining ownership of engineering decisions and the quality of the result. A strong eye for UI quality and polish. A self-directed approach, with the confidence to find problems and fix them without being asked. Comfort working from an ambiguous customer problem, proposing ideas and finding a small, useful change to test. Collaborative working style across Product, Design and Engineering. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Nice to haves Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiments, ideally with Statsig or a similar tool. Experience with large-scale consumer products used by millions of people. Agency or consulting background shipping across multiple products. Experience in consumer fintech, payments or crypto apps. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. title: Creative Strategist & Producer - Consumer
description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships. The opportunity Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own. This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made. You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life. Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience. Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers. Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process. Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp. Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast. Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response. React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself. Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea. Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on. What you bring 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category. A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed. A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction. Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated. A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it. A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it. Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one. Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas. A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon. Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements. Speed without sloppiness. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: We are currently seeking a talented and driven sales professional who will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be £20k to £200k, and typically involve technical POCs, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. This is a remote position open to candidates based in United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. Our breadth of work is limitless, as we challenge ourselves to innovate in all that we do and really make a difference. title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Deployment
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>Every change to Anthropic's software has to reach production somehow: new code, runtime configuration, feature flags, infrastructure changes. Our team builds the systems those changes travel through. Our mission is to give every team at Anthropic a fast, safe, and predictable path from change to production.</p> <p>You'll join the team within Anthropic's Infrastructure organization that owns pipelines, staged rollouts, health-gated promotion, and rollback, along with runtime configuration, feature flags, and the systems that deliver code and artifacts to machines across a very large fleet. You'll own a meaningful part of this end to end, from design through operating it in production.</p> <p>If you want your work to shape how fast and how safely Anthropic ships, this could be a great fit.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Set technical direction for major parts of the deployment platform and own them end to end: design, implementation, operations, and on-call</li> <li>Build rollout safety into the platform, including progressive delivery, health-gated promotion, automatic pause and rollback, and deploy controls that teams manage themselves</li> <li>Design APIs and abstractions that work equally well for engineers and for AI agents</li> <li>Extend the platform to new workload types and runtimes, from Kubernetes to serverless and edge platforms</li> <li>Build and operate runtime configuration and feature flag systems with validation, gradual rollout, and fast rollback</li> <li>Build infrastructure-as-code workflows that many teams rely on for safe, routine changes</li> <li>Scale artifact distribution so code and configuration reach machines quickly and efficiently</li> <li>Partner with Security so that the path to production is secure by default, with verifiable builds, least-privilege access, and auditable changes</li> <li>Work directly with teams across Anthropic to understand their deployment needs and bring their workloads onto the platform</li> <li>Take part in on-call and incident response, and turn what you learn into guardrails so the same problem can't recur</li> </ul> <h2>Minimum qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Proficiency in at least one backend or systems programming language, such as Rust, Go, C++, or Java</li> <li>Experience leading the design, building, and operation of distributed systems or infrastructure in production, including technical direction across teams</li> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads, such as Kubernetes on AWS or GCP</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Experience building deployment, release, or change management systems at large scale</li> <li>Experience with production on-call and incident response</li> <li>Experience with Rust in production</li> <li>Experience with progressive delivery and GitOps tooling, such as Argo CD or Argo Rollouts</li> <li>Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, including controllers and operators</li> <li>Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code systems at scale, including state management and locking</li> <li>Experience building feature flag, experimentation, or dynamic configuration systems</li> <li>Experience with artifact or package distribution, such as OCI registries, Nix, or content-addressed storage</li> <li>Experience with software supply chain security, such as signed build provenance</li> <li>Experience building high-throughput workflow engines or control planes backed by relational databases</li> <li>Experience building internal developer platforms and driving adoption across many teams</li> <li>Experience using AI agents in your own engineering work, or building systems that agents operate</li> </ul> <h2>Representative projects</h2> <ul> <li>Build operator controls for progressive rollouts, including pause and resume that preserve rollout state</li> <li>Design a deployment engine built on fine-grained targets and their dependencies, so each change rolls out exactly where it needs to</li> <li>Build cluster-health-aware rollouts that steer around unhealthy clusters</li> <li>Add a new workload type to the platform, including its rollout, verification, and rollback behavior</li> <li>Design a deployment control plane that handles sharp bursts of agent-driven traffic</li> <li>Design a distribution system that delivers configuration and artifacts to every machine in the fleet as demand grows</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. </p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£325,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£390,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong> We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>For roles performing work in California: </strong>We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit <u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u> directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong> Learn about <a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Research Engineer, AI Monitoring
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data.</p> <p>When a classifier flags an action, it can <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/news/improving-alignment-security-efforts" target="_blank">block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human</a>. This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design.</p> <p>The work combines research and production engineering:</p> <ul> <li> <p>The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/claude-code-auto-mode" target="_blank">Claude Code auto mode</a> and <a href="https://www.anthropic.com/research/next-generation-constitutional-classifiers" target="_blank">Constitutional Classifiers</a>.</p> </li> <li> <p>The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals</p> </li> <li> <p>Deploy, tune and operate these classifiers in the critical path of internal agents, RL training, and evaluations, and own their accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and failure behaviour</p> </li> <li> <p>Build the datasets, labelling pipelines, and evaluations that allow us to measure and improve our classifiers and harm taxonomies</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with red teaming colleagues to stress-test our classifiers, and harden them against what they find</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with the teams whose agents, environments, and evaluations we run on, so that false positives get fixed quickly without weakening protection</p> </li> <li> <p>Contribute to the team's direction, including what to build, what to partner on, and where to invest</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Minimum critically review code and experiment results, including work produced by AI agents</p> </li> <li> <p>Sincere interest in developing safe and beneficial AI systems</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Preferred qualifications</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Experience leading ambiguous technical projects and setting direction for other engineers or researchers</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience evaluating large language models, developing classifiers, or operating high-scale production systems where requirements change quickly</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building detection systems where true positives are rare and false You'll design the optimisation, forecasting and ML models at the core of it, and bring them into production together with backend engineers, data scientists, analysts and our operations teams. This is a hands-on role with a lot of technical ownership. You'll shape how we model the network and your work shows up in the routes our drivers take, the cages filled at our depots and the parcels that arrive on time. The problems are as varied as they are hard. How much volume will each depot see next week, and how many drivers and vehicles do we need to meet it? How should parcels flow through sortation and our collections network so nothing is handled twice? How do we turn each day's parcels into routes that are efficient, reliable and on time? And how do we model the cost and geography of our network as we expand into new cities? What You'll Be Doing 🚀 Build the models. Design and implement optimisation models and algorithms for routing, supply-demand matching, capacity planning and other core logistics challenges. Turn ambiguity into models. Take complex operational problems, break them down, and see them through from first investigation to production. Put models into production. Build and productionise optimisation, forecasting and ML models with our backend engineers, making them robust, observable and ready for peak volumes. Explore new approaches. Lead the exploration and evaluation of new approaches, from linear programming and heuristics to machine learning-based optimisation. Stay close to the operation. Work directly with operations teams, see how plans perform on the ground, and close the loop with data. Raise the bar. Lead design and code reviews, mentor engineers, and set the standards for how we test and evaluate our models. What We're Looking For 🔎 Typically 5+ years of experience building optimisation or ML models and shipping them into production systems. A track record of technical ownership beyond your own work: you've shaped the modelling approach or direction of systems spanning multiple components or teams. The ability to translate complex, ambiguous operational problems into technical solutions with measurable impact. Solid coding skills: Python preferred, though experience in other languages like C++, Java or Go is also valued. An appetite for hard optimisation problems: routing, scheduling, forecasting, supply-demand matching, or other constraint-heavy domains. Strong collaboration and written communication skills, with the confidence to work across engineering, data science, analytics and operations. You also bring depth in at least one of: Optimisation / operations research: linear and integer programming, constraint programming or heuristics, and integrating solvers such as OR-Tools or Gurobi into production systems. Machine learning: forecasting and predictive models that feed planning decisions, from development to monitoring in production. Technologies We Use 💻 Python, Go AWS (Lambda, ECS Fargate, Step Functions, SQS, EventBridge, Aurora PostgreSQL), CDK (TypeScript) GCP, BigQuery, Looker Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus GitHub, GitHub Actions Claude Code Event-driven architecture and domain-driven design Our interviewing process 🪜 Intro call with the hiring manager Live coding challenge solving a problem A take home case study, followed by a discussion On-site interview at our Shoreditch HQ (role and culture) Our Values 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate. 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence. 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.
