title: Network Production Engineer
description: About Fluidstack We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI. We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply! How We Operate Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible. Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. The Production Engineering Team Examples of key problems the team is working on Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal. Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up. Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it. Role Scope Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers. Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours. Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs. Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in. Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic. What We're Looking For The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it. You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution. You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone. You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet. You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again. You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero. Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling. title: Key Account Executive - UK
description: As Marqeta’s Key Account Executive based in London , you will be passionate about scaling the success of our business in Europe. This exciting role is ideal for individuals seeking to go deep in all aspects of complex business and technical engagements and will span multiple areas of development: (1) Cultivating and managing relationships with executives seeking to innovate and disrupt B2B & consumer payments; (2) Working closely with internal stakeholders in Product, Legal, Compliance and Delivery to define solutions that will empower our customers; and (3) Originating new customer opportunities, responding to inbound opportunities, and shepherding deals from opening through to contract and closing stage. The team at Marqeta focuses on the largest and most impactful commercial opportunities in Marqeta’s evolving business. These customers include established brands, fintech innovators and labour / retail marketplaces, all looking for solutions to launch, scale and continuously evolve their financial products and services. Key to this role is an ability to understand Marqeta's technology and how it brings value to the market, expertly communicate its benefits, and win the trust of the key stakeholders across revenue growth, product and technology teams of our potential partners. We're looking for a self-motivated, experienced solution seller, who is eager to further deepen their knowledge of embedded finance and possesses the business judgment and sales acumen to vet opportunities and close deals. In this role you will spend the first 3 months learning the ins and outs of Marqeta and our customers and our programme management capabilities, supporting Team Leads on strategic projects, and building a sales pipeline. Additionally, you will need to understand the process of selling a complex platform technology and be able to communicate technical and product benefits to both sophisticated and unsophisticated buyers. PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days. The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us! The Impact You'll Have This role is about generating and closing new opportunities while playing a key role supporting the Sales Director in setting the strategic vision for the business - here are a few key expectations: Closing and launching enterprise customers: Work alongside the team Director in identifying, closing and onboarding new customers. Manage the back end of the process including Salesforce rigour and reporting, financial modeling, and garnering internal approvals. Qualify leads and prioritize the right opportunities: Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects by identifying their needs and requirements, responding to requests for information and proposals, and vetting them against our current and future product offering. Run a Sales Process end to end: Manage real customer opportunities through a sales process, from initial engagement to scoping to final contract negotiations. At any given time, you will be responsible for partnering with the team to grow and renew existing accounts and working opportunities in various stages of that process in Salesforce. Contracting: Work with our Legal team as required to shepherd opportunities through the contracting process, including negotiation and execution. Know the Tech: Quickly get up to speed on Marqeta's technical and programme management capabilities, the unique features and customer benefits our platform offers and how to speak with confidence, knowledge and credibility about what we bring to our customers and prospects. Sell the partnership vision: Work with internal SMEs to identify and develop solutions for prospects who are trying to understand what makes Marqeta’s platform and service offering so exceptional and differentiated. Strong familiarity and ease with the fintech ecosystem, B2B technology applications and how technology platforms serve customer businesses. Financial Acumen. Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to work cross-functionally to deliver on the customer’s needs. Superior communication skills (interpersonal, verbal, email, and presentation) with the ability to successfully orchestrate the sales process by managing the time and resources of the team and specialist partners. title: Office Administrator
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring <strong>London Office Administrators </strong>to help take responsibility for the success of our London office. </p> <p>Our office administrators are part of our global business services team which covers business services, travel and logistics, events, expense management and administration. We look for positive team players who are self-driven and results oriented, with excellent attention to detail. The best candidates show that they are forward planners, reliable and determined, and keen to assume responsibility for projects, processes and policy. We are a unique global business, so we are not looking for candidates with extensive experience so much as excellent organisers and communicators who are keen to develop skills and strive for continuous improvement.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is an office-based role based in London.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Create a professional, positive and welcoming environment for colleagues and guests</li> <li>Proactive management of front-of-house, meeting rooms and desk space</li> <li>Clerical, administrative and logistical tasks such as ordering supplies, office equipment, and processing invoices</li> <li>Creating and maintaining relationships with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Cross team collaboration across the company</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent academics</li> <li>Excellent spoken and written English skills</li> <li>Responsible and accountable</li> <li>Self-awareness and thoughtfulness</li> <li>Ability to travel up to twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration</li> <li>Ability to grasp our existing technical systems and suggest improvements</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills</li> <li>Adaptability in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Pension and medical insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Global Director of Sales
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London | 💰£133,900 - £175,000 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a> ✨</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Our Monzo Business team ⭐</strong></p> <p>Monzo Business helps businesses manage their money, and more than +1 million businesses in the UK bank with us. Now, we’re exploring how we can help more established businesses switch to Monzo, across the UK and Europe.</p> <p>Many of those businesses have more complex needs. They may need help understanding whether Monzo is right for them, moving their banking, or getting the most from our products. A great conversation with the right person can make a real difference.</p> <p>We’ve started building a sales team and testing a more personal approach. We’re looking for someone to take those early learnings and build a repeatable, effective sales-led growth function for small and medium-sized businesses.</p> <p>This is a chance to build something new. You’ll help shape which customers we serve, where a human conversation adds the most value, and how Sales works alongside self-serve, Product, Marketing and Operations. You’ll build the team and the playbook—and stay close enough to the work to test, learn and change direction yourself.</p> <p>You’ll also have the opportunity to build an AI-native sales function from the start. We want someone who can rethink how the team finds, understands and serves customers: using AI and automation to remove work, improve decisions and give people more time for conversations that matter. That means experimenting, measuring what changes, and helping the team adopt better ways of working as the technology evolves.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead Sales for Monzo Business globally</strong>. You’ll define our sales strategy, build and lead the team, and be accountable for its performance and commercial impact. That means reaching and winning the right customers, improving conversion and productivity, and building a sales motion that can grow sustainably.</li> <li><strong>You’ll work closely with RevOps, Product and other teams</strong> to help shape the targets, insights, tools and customer journeys Sales needs, and use them to guide decisions and improve results. </li> <li><strong>Build the SMB sales motion</strong>. Turn what we’re learning from our pilot into a clear strategy for the businesses we can serve best. Test how inbound, outbound and self-serve journeys work together, and <strong>identify</strong> where a sales conversation makes a meaningful difference.</li> <li><strong>Make growth count</strong>. Scale a sales motion that brings more high-quality business customers to Monzo, focusing investment where Sales can drive incremental growth and deliver strong returns.</li> <li><strong>Build the team</strong>. Hire, coach and develop high-performing Sales teams and Sales Managers. Set clear expectations, create a culture of learning and accountability, and Put the right team structure, incentives and ways of working in place as we grow.</li> <li><strong>Design the system around the customer</strong>. Work with RevOps, Marketing, Partnerships and Operations on targeting, lead generation, routing, sales process, reporting and forecasting. Spot where the journey breaks down and bring people together to fix it.</li> <li><strong>Make Sales and Product ‘One Team’</strong>. Share what you learn from customers and the sales funnel with Product, and work together on the experience, capabilities and product signals that help the right businesses discover and get value from Monzo.</li> <li><strong>Build an AI-native way of working.</strong> Identify and test opportunities to redesign how the team works—from finding and prioritising prospects to preparing for conversations, following up, coaching and forecasting. Work with specialist teams to put useful tools and workflows in place, measure their impact and embed the ones that work.</li> <li><strong>Use data to guide our approach</strong>. Build a clear view of the funnel, productivity, customer quality and sales economics. Use evidence to guide where to invest, what to change and when we’re ready to scale.</li> <li><strong>Earn customers’ trust</strong>. Build a sales culture that puts customers first and delivers good outcomes, working with our Risk, Compliance and Legal teams as we grow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve built or substantially changed an SMB sales motion in an early or ambiguous environment, and helped it grow into a repeatable, high-performing operation. You can tell us what you built, what you learned and what changed as you scaled.</li> <li>You understand selling to small and medium-sized businesses, including how to build a relatively high-volume, efficient motion with shorter sales cycles. You know how to combine human conversations with digital journeys.</li> <li>You’re an experienced sales leader and coach. You’ve hired and developed teams, managed performance and helped people do their best work. You’re comfortable getting close to customers and deals yourself.</li> <li>You think about the whole system. You understand how customer acquisition, marketing, product, people, processes, data and technology fit together, and can see where a change in one part affects the rest.</li> <li>You use AI and automation in your own work and have applied them to change how the team operates. You can explain the problem you were solving, what you tested, how you brought people along and what difference it made. </li> <li>You’re a practical change leader. You have experience putting practical changes into action. You can review and improve established ways of working, make progress through ambiguity and help a team adopt new approaches.</li> <li>You know how to get the best from Revenue Operations. You understand the foundations of a healthy sales engine, from lead routing and CRM to forecasting, funnel analysis and sales productivity, and know how to build them with the people who specialise in them.</li> <li>You work well with Product and other teams. You can connect what customers need and what Sales is learning to product and business decisions, and bring people together around a shared outcome.</li> <li>You’re commercially sharp. You understand the economics of growth, use data to challenge assumptions and can balance near-term results with building for the long term. You know when to keep experimenting and when to scale.</li> <li>You might have built in financial services, technology or another business selling to businesses. We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than the exact path you took to get there.</li> <li>You don’t need to tick every box. If this role excites you and you think you could make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong><br>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £133,900 - £175,000 ➕ equity & Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍 This role is based in our London office</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong><br></strong><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Intro call with the recruiter</li> <li>30 min hiring manager call</li> <li>2 hours of technical and behavioural interviews</li> <li>Stakeholder chat</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.</p> <p>#LI-OS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. title: Senior Financial Control Analyst, 9 Month Fixed Term Contract
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>Senior Financial Control Analyst</strong></p> <p>📍London/Cardiff | 💰£56,000 - £75,000 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a></p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Financial Control Team:</strong></p> <p>Monzo is growing fast - new products, new markets and new locations. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges! We are looking to introduce a Senior Financial Control Analyst on a 9 Month Fixed Term Contract. </p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial HM Interview </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TP1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We work alongside our first line credit teams who design the products, decide who to lend to, set underwriting policy, identify customers who need help, manage the portfolio and report and measure credit risk.</p> <p>Within CIF, we are scaling up our Forecasting modelling and execution team to support the enhancement of modelling standards across Finance. The role holder will have the opportunity to lead a ‘consultancy style’ centre of excellence providing thought leadership on the methodological design and regulatory compliance assessment on all Financial forecasting models that feed the banks’ budgeting and stress-testing activities. This will expand to hands-on delivery of model developments, where appropriate. </p> <p>Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is experience in financial modelling and coding (Python and SQL preferred). Experience working in regulatory stress testing exercises (such as ICAAP or EBA Stress-testing) is highly desirable but not essential. </p> <p>We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://cloud.google.com/">Google Cloud Platform</a> for all of our analytics infrastructure</li> <li><a href="https://www.getdbt.com/">dbt</a> and<a href="https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/"><strong> </strong>BigQuery SQL</a> for our data modelling and warehousing</li> <li>Python for data science and predictive modelling and data visualisation (via streamlit)</li> <li>Anaplan for model implementation</li> <li>Github for version control</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assisting with continuous improvement of forecasting models via individual delivery or through others</li> <li>Development of best practices for financial modelling across Monzo</li> <li>Presenting forecast model results to senior management</li> <li>Close collaboration with portfolio strategy, model validation, finance and external audit teams</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a background in financial forecast modelling or execution</li> <li>You have strong analytical skills and a track record of using these to deliver technical projects</li> <li>You have a solid technical toolkit. SQL and Python are our desired coding languages but experience in SAS/R will be considered. A data visualisation tool (such as Streamlit or Looker) is a plus</li> <li>You can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> <li>You're impact driven and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, our products, our users and your team-mates</li> <li>You have a self-starter mindset<em>;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You're a team player<em> </em>whom your colleagues can rely on</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>Initial call with a member of the Forecasting team</li> <li>Technical modelling interview </li> <li>Values and collaboration behavioural interview</li> <li>A live case study problem solving interview</li> </ol> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,000 to £106,800 + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>  </p> <p>📍 London (one day a week)</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p> </p> <p><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">#LI-JH1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. We’re looking for Senior Technical Program Managers to join our Engineering teams across Payments and Business Banking, helping us deliver complex, high-impact programmes as we continue to grow.</p> <p>Depending on the team you join, you could be:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Payments</strong>: helping us ship more and better payment products, working across teams to solve complex technical challenges and improve how money moves for millions of customers.</li> <li><strong>Business Banking</strong>: helping us build Monzo into the financial control centre for SMEs. We’re looking for people who can bring clarity to complex technical programmes, influence across teams and help turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes for our customers.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of launching payment products that cross multiple teams and disciplines</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programs: <ul> <li>Define program roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers and speed up delivery</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of experience managing complex technology programs or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You are able to communicate clearly and persuasively to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership</li> <li>You are comfortable in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be a part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and identify/mitigate delivery risks proactively; They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p><strong>Help build the future of customer operations</strong></p> <p>We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. title: Linux Desktop Support Engineer (London UK office)
description: <p>This is an opportunity to kickstart your career by joining Canonical. You will be working from our Canonical London Office and will be accountable for delivering technical support to our employees and customers, as well as facilitating AV support for office conferences and events. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</p> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>While our engineers regularly solve deeply interesting, complex technical problems - from triaging cloud environments to root-cause analysis on unseen Linux kernel crashes - this is fundamentally a role rooted in human connection. You will act as a trusted peer and technical guide to external engineering teams, translating intricate open-source challenges into clear, empathetic solutions. We are rapidly expanding and looking for brilliant problem solvers who are just as passionate about building strong, collaborative relationships with customers as they are about the next generation of Canonical solutions.</p> <p>Location: Office Based in London, England.</p> <h2><strong>The role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Empathetic Engagement:</strong> Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Problem Solving:</strong> Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.</li> <li><strong>True Ownership:</strong> Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.</li> <li><strong>Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance:</strong> Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Advocacy:</strong> Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.</li> <li><strong>Operational Reliability:</strong> Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What are we looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Communication Excellence:</strong> Exceptional written and spoken English, with a natural ability to convey technical complexity clearly, warmly, and compellingly.</li> <li><strong>The Soft-Skill Edge:</strong> A genuine passion for helping people, paired with the emotional intelligence to navigate high-stakes technical situations with composure and empathy.</li> <li><strong>Academic Dedication:</strong> Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li><strong>Educational Background:</strong> An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.</li> <li><strong>On-Site Technical Leadership:</strong> Based in our state-of-the-art London, UK office, you will serve as a key technical support resource for our local teams and employees.</li> <li><strong>Driven Mindset:</strong> A proven track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Cloud Familiarity:</strong> Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to three or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li><em>Virtualization & Cloud:</em> Using KVM or OpenStack.</li> <li><em>Containers:</em> primarily Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.</li> <li><em>Storage Ecosystems:</em> Block, object, and network storage technologies.</li> <li><em>System Networking:</em> Navigating bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, or MTU tuning.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Analytical Curiosity:</strong> A strong troubleshooting mindset—the ability to look into stack traces or logs, identify OS/application-level bugs, and strategically guide the customer through next steps.</li> <li><strong>Development Fundamentals:</strong> Basic programming logic in any language to help parse code and collaborate effectively with Canonical Engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Manager of Forward Deployed Engineering on Notion’s Services team, you will lead a team responsible for the hands-on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. Your team will design, build, and deploy production-ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business. You will combine people leadership, technical judgment, and customer-facing delivery. You will coach Forward Deployed Engineers through discovery, architecture, implementation, and launch while remaining close enough to the work to guide difficult technical decisions, unblock delivery, and build trust with senior customer stakeholders. The team’s work includes custom code, production-grade agents and AI workflows using MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, as well as integrations, data pipelines, enterprise migrations, and complex challenges involving scale, permissions, and governance. You will help establish how Services delivers complex technical implementations across EMEA. This includes building a high-performing team, improving delivery standards and reusable technical assets, partnering with Sales, Product, CX, and Engineering, and turning lessons from customer deployments into product and platform improvements. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Lead, coach, and develop a team of Forward Deployed Engineers delivering complex enterprise customer engagements across EMEA. - Create a high-performance team environment with clear expectations, strong technical standards, effective feedback, and meaningful career development. - Own the quality and outcomes of engagements from technical discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, launch, and handover. - Act as a trusted technical and delivery advisor to customer engineering, IT, security, and business leaders, helping them make informed architectural decisions and deepen their use of Notion. - Guide the design, build, and operation of custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows. - Oversee large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, cutover, and post-migration optimization. - Review technical designs and implementation plans, identify delivery risks early, and step in directly when an engagement requires senior technical leadership. - Partner with Sales and Services leaders on qualification, feasibility, scoping, effort estimation, staffing, and delivery planning for strategic opportunities. - Balance customer priorities, team capacity, and technical complexity to make sound staffing and sequencing decisions. - Help define and scale the operating model for Forward Deployed Engineering, including hiring, onboarding, delivery methodologies, quality reviews, documentation, and engineering best practices. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 8+ years of experience in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, professional services, customer engineering, software engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role. - 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading engineers responsible for customer-facing technical delivery. - A strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing technical teams. - Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python, with the technical depth to review production-quality code and guide implementation decisions. - Hands-on experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, data transformation, and production systems. - Experience leading technical discovery, assessing feasibility, identifying risks, scoping work, estimating effort, and translating ambiguous requirements into executable plans. - Strong architectural judgment and debugging skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations, data quality, automation logic, system limits, and customer-specific environments. - Demonstrated success managing multiple complex customer engagements while maintaining quality, team health, and clear stakeholder communication. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business audiences from practitioners through executive stakeholders. - A customer- and outcomes-oriented approach, with sound judgment about when to standardize, when to customize, and how to manage tradeoffs. NICE TO HAVES - Experience building or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or customer engineering function in a startup or high-growth environment. - Experience deploying AI agents in complex coding or business workflows. - Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows involving MCP, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval or RAG systems, or workflow orchestration. - Experience with ETL or ELT workflows, schema mapping, validation scripts, and large-scale content or data migration tooling. - Experience partnering with product and engineering teams to influence roadmaps or architectural decisions based on customer implementation needs. - Experience supporting pre-sales and early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, prototypes, and custom scripts. - Experience establishing technical delivery standards, quality review processes, discovery methodologies, or internal engineering tooling from the ground up. - A strong track record of successful enterprise implementations across multiple industries or regions. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21 #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

title: Group Financial Controller
location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Group Financial Controller</strong>.</p> <p>The ideal candidate has a deep passion for systems accounting, a track record of preparing finance functions for public markets and an innovative mindset that leverages technology and AI to build efficient and robust accounting workflows.<br>The Accounting team ensures the integrity of our financial information and serves as the primary stewards of the business’ financial health. They design and operate a governance framework underpinned by robust policies, controls and systems to provide oversight and challenge to the business. The team is responsible for timely and accurate reporting and exercises judgment when necessary based on a commitment to conservative and accurate reporting, a deep understanding of accounting principles and insights into our business.</p> <p>We are looking for a professionally qualified accounting leader who has a deep sense of right and wrong, high integrity, and a strong sense of responsibility, understanding that the accuracy of their work is critical to the entire Company. </p> <p>You are a methodical, detail-oriented, and process-driven problem-solver who enjoys investigating discrepancies to find their root cause. You are resilient under pressure, particularly during month-end and year-end closes, and motivated by the goal of achieving a perfect, timely, and reliable result.</p> <p>Perhaps unusually we prefer a leader with deep personal interest in the software and technology industry, and some data analytics, AI and ideally software engineering experience.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. It will report to our Chief Financial Officer.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Ensuring strong understanding of the risks associated with our processes and systems and leading the development and implementation of controls to mitigate those risks</li> <li>Leading the development and identification of areas of improvement of Canonical’s policies and procedures that will enable the business to scale efficiently</li> <li>Driving the implementation of the Canonical’s policies and procedures and the monitoring of compliance </li> <li>Supporting multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy</li> <li>Managing reviews of weekly, month-end, year-end processes from balance sheet reconciliations to management accounts and statutory accounts preparation to ensure timely and accurate reporting of financial information</li> <li>Ensuring accuracy and completeness of the recording and reporting of financial data and transactions to ensure that the Company maintains robust accounting records</li> <li>Upholding the Company’s accounting and approval processes and controls across the organization</li> <li>Managing external audits </li> <li>Developing a strong understanding of the evolving regulatory frameworks and jurisdictions in which Canonical operates and lead the assurance of Canonical’s compliance with such regulatory requirements</li> <li>Driving projects associated with upgrading or implementing new finance systems and sensible AI adoption in the team</li> <li>Developing professional relationships and manage communications with both internal and external stakeholders - customers, vendors, tax authorities and external advisers -  including resolving questions and issues confidentially and  in a timely manner</li> <li>Managing or mentoring junior accounting staff, sharing knowledge and promoting best practices</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>A strong academic background and professional qualification in Accounting or Finance (e.g. ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA, or equivalent)</li> <li>Extensive practical IFRS knowledge and experience</li> <li>Advanced Excel skills and strong data analysis capabilities</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced setting</li> <li>Confident communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with colleagues, management, customers, and external stakeholders</li> <li>A proactive, analytical mindset with a genuine passion for finance and a drive for continuous improvement, process efficiency and professional development</li> <li>Proven experience using enterprise-level accounting or ERP systems</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with NetSuite</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce</li> <li>Experience with a Big 4 Accounting Firm, or a Public company</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Tax Senior Associate

description: <h1>Tax Senior Associate</h1> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring a <strong>Tax Senior Associate,</strong> reporting to the CFO. This role covers multiple Canonical corporate entities in several countries. We have a preference for candidates in EMEA time zones.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>astute and forward-thinking tax professional</strong> to build a tax function from the ground up at a profitable, fast-growing technology company. We're looking for someone with a keen interest in technology and how technology is changing the tax profession, who can translate that insight into a modern, effective strategy and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the CFO, you will <strong>design and own the tax processes</strong> that support our global expansion. Your primary challenge will be navigating the complexity of the evolving global environment in which we operate, where tax rules are constantly evolving. You will work with the CFO to establish a scalable and efficient framework fit for a dynamic, global software business—tackling everything from digital services taxes to leveraging new tax technologies.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and strategic thinking</strong> over years of experience. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, a professional qualification in accounting and tax and demonstrable exposure to global tax considerations in a multinational context.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong><em>This role will be based remotely in the EMEA region, or may be office based in London, UK</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Manage and coordinate the preparation and review of corporate tax, VAT, and other relevant tax returns for our entities, ensuring timely and accurate filings</li> <li>Work with external advisers to develop transfer pricing documentation and tax planning initiatives and lead their implementation</li> <li>Act as a key point of contact for tax authority audits and enquiries, preparing responses and supporting documentation in collaboration with external advisors.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to streamline and improve tax processes, controls, and data management to enhance efficiency and accuracy particularly using technology and automation</li> <li>Manage and run tax provisioning and reporting under IFRS, including calculating effective tax rates and preparing tax-related disclosures for financial statements</li> <li>Work closely with the wider finance team, legal, and business operations to provide tax support and ensure cross-functional alignment</li> <li>Monitor changes in tax legislation across the regions in which we operate and assess their potential impact on the company.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in business, finance, economics, technology or other quantitative field</li> <li>Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA) and tax advisor (CTA, ADIT or equivalent)</li> <li>A minimum of 3-5 years of relevant tax experience, gained within a Big 4/Top 10 accounting firm or a multinational in-house tax team.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability</li> <li> Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex tax concepts to non-tax stakeholders</li> <li>Thoughtfulness and self-motivation</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leadership ability</li> <li>Software or tech industry experience</li> <li>Public company finance and reporting experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
